newsitem.title: UK: Russian oil port Novorossiisk reopens.
newsitem.headline: Russian oil port Novorossiisk reopens.

text.p: Leading Russian oil terminal Novorossiisk reopened to tanker loading and berthing early on Tuesday after poor weather closed the port on Sunday, shipping inspector Petrak said.
The port had completed three days of pipeline maintenance on schedule on Saturday but poor weather closed the port at 0500 local time on Sunday and remained shut until 0100 local time on Tuesday.
Winds had eased to force 3-4 on the Beaufort scale on Tuesday morning after hitting force 8-9 on Monday.
Two crude tankers were loading on Tuesday and three crude tankers, two fuel oil vessels and a gas oil tanker were at anchor.
